description: MCP server for a secret vault that gives agents scoped, short-lived access to secrets, signing keys, execution bindings, memory, automations, and security inspection tools without placing raw secrets in model context.

notes: Stdio mode uses ONECLAW_AGENT_API_KEY for vault access. The hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint accepts the agent API key as a bearer token. Local-only security inspection can run without vault credentials by setting ONECLAW_LOCAL_ONLY=true.
Issue #1970 and the public README confirm the npm package, hosted endpoint, stdio/httpStream transport modes, API-key auth, local-only mode, and 126-tool count. The tool count remains self-reported.
